def same(a,b):
    if type(a) is not type(b): return False
    if isinstance(b,dict): return a.keys()==b.keys() and all(same(a[k],v) for k,v in b.items())
    if isinstance(b,list): return len(a)==len(b) and all(same(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
    return a==b
